address: 15, Lane 233, Section 1, Dunhua South Road, Da'an District, Taipei, Taiwan
bio: The warm-hued room sports rustic LATAM charm, depicted by cacti against a terracotta backdrop paired with vibrant, sensual touches. Named after the chef’s parents, Fon-Cé captures the varied culinary landscapes of LATAM with passion and delicacy. Inspired by buñuelo, a fried dough fritter enjoyed throughout the continent, the chickpea with chicken liver pâté and caramelised coconut sauce stands out with a bold, flavourful twist.
